channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Economy undergoes structural shift ending low-cost era, with inflation and rate regime change cited as outcome
item.description: The shift returns the economy in many ways to where it was before the financial crisis that ran from December 2007 through June 2009.

item.title: U.S. economy reaches pivotal milestone as data center and hardware spending exceeds housing investment
item.description: "We're seeing a pivotal shift in the US economy: investment is shifting away from residential investment and towards computers."

item.title: Trump says he will convert planned arch into 'top grade military complex' for drones, snipers and ammunition
item.description: Trump said in a social media post that he agreed, at the military's "strong request," to make the changes to his arch.

item.title: AI agents act on agreements as machines surpass human intelligence
item.description: AI leaders concur that frontier development must be paced, yet they lack incentive to limit themselves. Others may step in.
